description: Census ACS resident characteristics (housing costs, income, education, occupation mix) with published 90% margins of error, plus BLS QCEW private-industry jobs, pay and year-over-year growth by NAICS code with a national reference row, for one US county by FIPS code or name. Resident and workplace populations are different and must not be combined into one rate; missing and suppressed values are unavailable, not zero. Describes a place, not any company's operating or revenue exposure. For research and education only; not financial advice.

county.description: County FIPS code (e.g. 48453) or name with state (e.g. "Travis, Texas"). An ambiguous name returns a candidate list rather than a guess.
